text.description_html:
Fusion PH-C2, Navajo Wall Mounted Toilet Paper Holder

The Navajo Toilet Tissue Holder has a unique style that is reminiscent of traditional southwest decor. Because of this, it is a must have for ranch-styles houses. The Navajo Toilet Paper holder is available in 3 finishes--choose from antique copper, antique pewter, or oil rubbed bronze. Since it is made by Fusion Hardware, you know that it is made out of high quality materials that can withstand the hot and damp environment of the bathroom.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-C2 Blacksmith Towel Bar, Fusion TR-C2 Blacksmith Towel Ring, and Fusion RH-C2 Blacksmith Robe Hook

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Navajo Collection Toilet Paper Holder:

  • Mount Length: 4-3/4"
  • Mount Width: 2-5/8"
  • Reversible to hang in either direction.
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
